about.body:
I'm a product designer who moves fluidly between marketplace products and fintech risk tooling — two worlds that both reward the same thing: clarity under constraint.

My work spans discovery, systems-level thinking, and pixel-level craft. I care about interfaces that hold up under real use — dense data, high-stakes decisions, and the everyday moments in between.

Outside of client and product work, I spend time refining design systems and exploring how motion and interaction can make complex tools feel effortless.

projects.title: Card Controls & Fraud Review
projects.summary: A redesigned card-control and fraud-review experience for fleet spend management, reducing time-to-decision for risk analysts.
projects.challenge: Analysts were switching between four tools to approve or block card transactions, and the existing UI buried risk signals below the fold.
projects.solution: Consolidated risk signals, card rules, and MCC limits into a single reviewable surface with clear, reversible actions and inline audit history.
outcomes: Shipped as the template for two adjacent risk workflows

projects.title: Marketplace Listings Redesign
projects.summary: A ground-up redesign of listing creation and discovery for a regional auto marketplace, improving completion rate and lead quality.
projects.challenge: Sellers dropped off mid-listing due to a long, unguided form, and buyers struggled to compare listings with inconsistent data.
projects.solution: Introduced a guided multi-step flow with smart defaults, and standardized listing cards around a shared data schema.

projects.title: Talent Marketplace Design System
projects.summary: A token-based design system unifying a CRM and talent-marketplace product across web and internal tools.
projects.challenge: Two product surfaces had diverged visually and technically, slowing every new feature down with one-off components.
projects.solution: Built a shared token layer and component library adopted by both product teams, with documented usage guidelines.
outcomes: Cut new-feature design time by a third
Single source of truth adopted org-wide
